item.title: World News Today, 8 October 2026: Kramatorsk bus strike, Houthi attacks on Saudi airports, Nobel for Anne Carson
item.description: A Russian glide-bomb strike on two buses in Kramatorsk killed at least 30 people, Houthi attacks on two Saudi airports killed three, Israel moved to shut Britain's consulate in East Jerusalem, and Canadian poet Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in Literature. Every item below was checked against at least two independent sources.

item.title: Why the Opposition wants CEC Gyanesh Kumar to resign — the Delhi protests explained
item.description: INDIA bloc MPs have protested on Delhi's streets for two straight days, demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar step down over the SIR voter-roll revision. Here is what happened, what each side says, and what comes next.

item.title: GPT-6 is coming to free ChatGPT users: what "Intelligent UI" is and what changes for you
item.description: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to every ChatGPT tier, including Free and Go. The headline feature, Intelligent UI, lets answers come with charts, maps, buttons and small tools instead of just text. Here is what is new and when you get it.

item.title: Drishyam 3: The Conclusion box office: Ajay Devgn film crosses Rs 232 crore in 6 days
item.description: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has collected Rs 232.50 crore net in India in six days, with worldwide gross around Rs 364 crore. Day-by-day numbers, audience reaction, and what to watch this weekend.
